translationRepairs: In the eighth month of autumn, on the renwu day, the grand empress dowager deposed Emperor Fei as Prince of Jinan with the income of a single commandery, and installed the grand chief minister, Prince Yan of Changshan, as successor to the throne.

In the eighth month of autumn, on the renwu day, the grand empress dowager demoted Emperor Fei to Prince of Jinan with the income of a single commandery, and installed the grand chief minister, Prince Yan of Changshan, as successor to the throne.

s0047’s 廢帝爲濟南王 means the grand empress dowager stripped him of the emperorship and made him Prince of Jinan. English “deposed … as Prince of Jinan” wrongly suggests Prince of Jinan was the office removed; “demoted … to Prince of Jinan” matches the Chinese construction.
When his attendants asked why, the crown prince said, "This is where Shizong was killed; the Prince of Hejian has no place here."
When his attendants asked why, the crown prince said, "This is where Shizong met the assassins; why should the Prince of Hejian be here again?"
世宗遇賊處 is the place where Shizong met the assassins/bandits, not an explicit “was killed,” and 復何宜在此 includes 復 “again.” The proposed wording restores both points without adding unstated content.
